critical_code_review_comments: Cheating-listener fix uses refs (sessionRef, warningsRef, currentQuestionIndexRef) — correct pattern. cheatingCancelledRef short-circuits further triggers after the 2nd warning, but the listeners themselves are NOT removed; if the 2s navigate is delayed/cancelled, further visibility events would still try to setState on an unmounted component. Acceptable since navigation is reliable, but could remove listeners inside the cancel branch.

submitInterview navigates with setTimeout(800ms) AFTER the deep-analysis await chain (can be 20-40s with LLM). User cannot cancel; consider a soft escape hatch or pushing deep-analysis to a background task and polling on /results.
Dashboard filtering is duplicated (computed once for stats, once again inside the history Card via IIFE). Minor DRY — extract once and reuse.

ResumeAnalyzer.jsx 'Improvement Suggestions' Card sits inside the px-8 page container, so on 1920 viewport it caps at ~1216px; user spec said '> 1000px' so PASS, but the section is not truly viewport-full. Acceptable per spec.
Same prior comments still stand: server.py size (~895 lines), /api/videos lacks auth/traversal guard, idempotency cache keyed only on len(answers).

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 bug-fix items from iteration 4 are verified PASS. Stale-closure fix uses refs + a useEffect bound on `session`. Evaluating overlay = data-testid='evaluating-overlay' inside InterviewRoomWithVideo.jsx (renders when submitting state is true, BEFORE navigate to /results). Dashboard filters on (answers.length>0 && evaluated_at). To re-test cheating warnings without a real tab-switch, do: Object.defineProperty(document,'hidden',{value:true,configurable:true}); document.dispatchEvent(new Event('visibilitychange')).
rca of the issue: Original stale-closure bug: setupCheatingDetection ran once at mount when session state was still null, so the if(session) guard inside the handler always returned false. Fix: a new useEffect that depends on `session` registers visibilitychange/blur/focus listeners and reads warnings/currentQuestionIndex via refs that are kept in sync by sibling useEffects — handler always sees fresh state. Verified by visibility-change stub firing the modal and incrementing the counter from 0->1->2 with auto-cancel.
